name: airport
description: Connection details for an Arrow Flight server. Used by ATTACH to establish a database connection and by the discovery/operations functions when invoked with a secret reference.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Arrow Flight server URI, e.g. grpc://host:8815 or grpc+tls://host:8815

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Bearer token sent in the Authorization header

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Optional filter passed to ListFlights for discovery

examples.description: Create a secret for a TLS-protected Flight server
Attach the database identified by the secret
examples.code:
ATTACH 'my_flight' AS remote (TYPE airport);
SELECT * FROM remote.public.events LIMIT 10;
